newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex results don't shift view on bonds- Santander.
newsitem.headline: Cemex results don't shift view on bonds- Santander.

text.p: Mexican cement producer Cemex's third quarter results didn't give any compelling reason to believe its Eurobonds will outperform other Mexican soverign or corporate issues, Santander Investment's debt analyst Jim Garvey said on Monday.
"People are looking for signs that make things more bond friendly and they have not seen them in the results," said Garvey.
Garvey said that since the issuance of four-and 10-year paper in July, the bonds have performed well, given spread tightening among sovereign instruments.
"The company's yield curve, however, remains steep, suggesting market discomfort with ongoing event risk -- namely the company's continued expansion instinct," he said in a report.
Earnings per share for Cemex were 0.92 pesos in the third quarter, slightly below forecasts.

The company's operating income was 2.776 billion pesos for the first nine months, up from 2.653 billion for the same period in 1995, while net profits were 5.611 billion pesos for the first nine months, down sharply from 7.054 billion pesos in the same period in 1995.
